limit: A row is a string, so this catches the model and the renderer together and cannot say which of the two moved. It cannot be re-derived without the archive: the tests that read it without one assert on its own contents, which is a different job. The rows are read on the grid settings.toml declares, because _on_grid filters one demo of this archive down to it permanently -- so the table is the report on THAT grid and not on whatever grid a demo happens to be parsed at. It is an observation and not a rule: importing a demo changes these rows legitimately, and the answer is then to measure the table again and say so in the commit.
note: EVERY pistol block of every recorded team, keyed team/map/side/pistol, with the route rows as the view renders them from the real archive (Stories 4.11 and 4.13). Produced by running tests/test_calibration._route_blocks_from over the archive -- the same code path the test that reads it back uses -- so the file records what the tool produces and not a hand-written expectation. Since Story 4.13 the route reads every sample point, compresses each player's path to the product owner's junctions and speaks his callouts (src/pappascout/callouts.toml). The rows carry callouts, player counts and measured seconds only: the block's heading, which names the opponent and the date, is DELIBERATELY NOT HERE -- the repository is public and the denylist that guards it lives outside the repository (AD-12). What the heading states is pinned without the names in match_counts.json's played table.
